variant: Use addresses of the 32 LUT entries in dotQ4PairBlock64. Keep FP32 accumulation and the complete projection dispatch identical.
host: Apple M4, macOS 26.4.1, Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64, four workers and GOMAXPROCS=4

disassembly.count: Static MOVD from a general-purpose register to an offset of RSP and FLDPS from an offset of RSP inside the symbol. Exclude frame setup and link-register saves.
disassembly.purpose: Check whether address loads remove the paired table-copy spill pattern on this Go arm64 build.

synthetic.cases: Llama 3.2 3B dimensions for Gate/Up, Down, Q/O, K/V, two input rows. Gate/Up one- and four-row same-path controls.
synthetic.screen: Both Gate/Up and Down two-row candidate/reference ratios of process medians must be at most 0.95. Report all adjacent pair ratios and same-path controls.

model.command: python3 -S scripts/compare_inference.py --model MODEL_SNAPSHOT --id llama32-3b --baseline-ref 0e034974880d4c8d28aef7344eab8d9ebe9d2a28 --weight-format q4-mixed --case-order balanced --output-dir runs/pair-lut/model
model.cases: One and two sessions; 8-token prefixes; 7 decode calls; FP32 KV; three measured trials per case in each process.
model.screen: Exact prompt, generated IDs, logit and KV digests and equal workspace. Two-session decode candidate/reference median ratio at most 0.95, with both process pairs faster. Single-session decode and both prefill control median ratios at most 1.05.
model.interpretation: Screening result on this workload. A failed or unstable screen stays in the record. A pass would justify a separate confirmation before changing the default.
